2610.12303.title: Learning Probabilistic Logic Programs with Functional Gradient Guided Language Models
2610.12303.paper_summary: Declarative logic programs offer a powerful and interpretable abstraction for encoding relational structure and neurosymbolic reasoning, by expressing dependencies as weighted compositional rules. However, inducing them from data remains fundamentally hard, bottlenecked by the combinatorial explosion of symbolic search spaces. LLMs have recently emerged as powerful hypothesis generators, but when used in isolation, they lack the capacity to do systematic inductive reasoning needed to reliably synthesize valid programs that fit complex relational distributions. We introduce grasp (Gradient-boosted Synthesis of Probabilistic logic programs), a neurosymbolic framework that casts relational structure learning as functional gradient boosting in which the weak learner is a first-order rule and the intractable inner search is delegated to an LLM proposal oracle. We evaluate grasp on four relational benchmarks spanning molecular toxicity prediction (Tox21), mutagenesis, and citation matching (Cora), and show that it improves over purely symbolic, neural, and LLM-based baselines, while producing interpretable weighted rule ensembles. By replacing combinatorial search with gradient-guided LLM hypothesis generation, grasp retains boosting guarantees without sacrificing the transparency of symbolic outputs.
2610.12303.paper_summary_zh: 宣告式邏輯程式提供了一種強大且可解釋的抽象方式，用於編碼關係結構和神經符號推理，通過將依賴關係表達為加權的組合規則。然而，從數據中誘導它們仍然根本上很困難，因為符號搜索空間的組合爆炸成為瓶頸。大型語言模型（LLMs）最近作為強大的假設生成器出現，但當單獨使用時，它們缺乏進行系統性歸納推理的能力，這是可靠地合成符合複雜關係分佈的有效程式所需的。我們介紹了 grasp（增強型概率邏輯程式合成），這是一個神經符號框架，將關係結構學習視為功能梯度提升，其中弱學習者是一階規則，而難以處理的內部搜索則委託給 LLM 提議的預言者。我們在四個關係基準上評估 grasp，涵蓋分子毒性預測（Tox21）、突變性和引用匹配（Cora），並顯示它在純符號、神經和基於 LLM 的基準上有所改善，同時產生可解釋的加權規則集。通過用梯度引導的 LLM 假設生成替代組合搜索，grasp 保留了提升保證，而不犧牲符號輸出的透明度。
